checks.detail: for the exact heterogeneous control A=sum L_i G_i^-1 is positive definite; the general proof is the positive quadratic-form sum

checks.detail: ordinary no-source seams give one common momentum c; field closure A c=0 then forces c=0 and every slope G_i^-1 c=0

checks.detail: with one common response matrix, det A=(sum L_i)^2/det G is nonzero whenever the inherited Delta_G nondegeneracy holds; positivity is not needed

checks.detail: T=-I transports momentum consistently with a slope reversal; this is a conditional bundle-chart witness, not a registered F02 completion
